turns.prompt: Create an original repeat-pattern study based on the woven cloth's irregular rhythm. Do not extract or trace its actual motif. Show A using clustered rosette-like marks and B using a different branching grammar, with the same limited palette. Each full sheet must show a base tile next to a two-by-two repeat at the same scale so edge joins can be inspected. I want irregular local placement that still joins continuously across opposite tile edges, rather than a visible grid of identical centers. Expose the seed, mark scale, local offset range, and tile size in source.py and parameters.json. Produce a separately labeled parameter-probe render from one actual setting change and explain the rule that keeps the edge joins consistent. Deliver a.svg, a.png, b.svg, b.png, source.py, parameters.json, parameter-probe.svg, parameter-probe.png, notes.md. Keep these filenames on every turn. PNG previews must use the declared dimensions; include actual rendered results, not an empty placeholder. PNG sizes: 960x720.

Choose A for its edge continuity, not its crowded middle. Keep B unchanged. Reduce A's mark scale while keeping the seed, motif-center locations, tile size, and edge-join rule fixed. The local spacing should read more clearly without making a new distribution. Show both the base tile and repeated surface again. Deliver a.svg, a.png, b.svg, b.png, source.py, parameters.json, parameter-probe.svg, parameter-probe.png, notes.md. Keep these filenames on every turn. PNG previews must use the declared dimensions; include actual rendered results, not an empty placeholder. PNG sizes: 960x720.

Keep that spacing. Refine only color assignment so neighboring marks do not merge into one dark band at the tile edge; preserve the mark geometry, centers, and palette colors. The repeat should remain continuous without a frame hiding the seam. Record which parameters changed and rerun the same-seed probe. Deliver a.svg, a.png, b.svg, b.png, source.py, parameters.json, parameter-probe.svg, parameter-probe.png, notes.md. Keep these filenames on every turn. PNG previews must use the declared dimensions; include actual rendered results, not an empty placeholder. PNG sizes: 960x720.
